en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a war memorial made of large stone blocks with domed elements and the inscription "TREUE UM TREUE" on its entablature. The memorial stands on a small hill with low stone walls in front. In the background to the left is a large multi‑storey timber building resembling an inn or lodge, surrounded by trees and open ground. Printed German text appears at the top, and a red hand-written number is in the upper right corner.
